## Epidemic phase

```{r}
raw = read.csv("Data/raw_data.csv")
```

```{r}
oracle <- raw %>%
  group_by(location, target_end_date) %>%
  slice_max(reference_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(location, target_end_date, oracle_value) %>%
  arrange(location, target_end_date)

trend_df <- oracle %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  mutate(
    MA3        = rollmean(oracle_value, k = 3, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    pct_change = (MA3 - lag(MA3)) / lag(MA3) * 100,
    trend = case_when(
      pct_change > 5  ~ "Increasing",
      pct_change < -5 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE            ~ "Stable"
    ),
    trend = factor(trend, levels = c("Decreasing", "Stable", "Increasing"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(location, target_end_date, trend)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))
nrow(standard_wis) 

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))
nrow(standard_wis) 
```

## Granularity

```{r}
state_locations <- c(
  "colorado", "georgia", "indiana", "maine", "maryland",
  "massachusetts", "minnesota", "north-carolina", "oregon",
  "south-carolina", "texas", "utah", "virginia"
)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  mutate(
    granularity = if_else(location %in% state_locations, "state", "local"),
    granularity = factor(granularity, levels = c("local", "state"))
  )

table(standard_wis$granularity)
standard_wis %>% distinct(location, granularity) %>% arrange(granularity, location)

# LOG
log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  mutate(
    granularity = if_else(location %in% state_locations, "state", "local"),
    granularity = factor(granularity, levels = c("local", "state"))
  )

table(log_standard_wis$granularity)
log_standard_wis %>% distinct(location, granularity) %>% arrange(granularity, location)
```

## Pop data

```{r}

# county
counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2022) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, STATEFP)

# OMB MSA delineation file
library(readxl)
## you can download this data from here https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/metro-micro/about/delineation-files.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com
msa <- read_excel("Data/list1_2023.xlsx",skip = 2)
msa <- msa %>%
  mutate(
    GEOID = sprintf("%02d%03d",
                    as.numeric(`FIPS State Code`),
                    as.numeric(`FIPS County Code`))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, `CBSA Code`)

# county → state → MSA 연결
state_msa <- counties_sf %>%
  left_join(msa, by = "GEOID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`CBSA Code`))

# state별 MSA 개수
msa_count <- state_msa %>%
  group_by(STATEFP) %>%
  summarise(MSA_count = n_distinct(`CBSA Code`))

st_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2022)

st_name <- st_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(STATEFP, NAME) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

msa_count <- msa_count %>%
  left_join(st_name, by = "STATEFP") %>%
  rename(n_msa = MSA_count)
```

```{r}
locations <- read.csv("Data/locations.csv")

state_pop <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = "B01003_001",  # total population
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(state = NAME, population = B01003_001E)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(locations %>% 
              dplyr::select(state, location, population), 
            by = c("location")) %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = "state", suffix = c("",".state")) %>%
  left_join(msa_count %>%
              dplyr::select(-STATEFP), by = c("state" = "NAME")) %>%
  mutate(pop_ratio = population/population.state)

log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(locations %>% 
              dplyr::select(state, location, population), 
            by = c("location")) %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = "state", suffix = c("",".state")) %>%
  left_join(msa_count %>%
              dplyr::select(-STATEFP), by = c("state" = "NAME")) %>%
  mutate(pop_ratio = population/population.state)
```

# Models

We write log_raw_normal_identity = LRNI, log_log_normal_identity = LLRI, none_raw_tweedie_log = NRTL

## LRNI
```{r}
length(standard_wis |> filter(wis == 0))
standard_wis = standard_wis |> filter(wis != 0)
```

```{r}
LRNI <- lmer(
  log(wis) ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) + (1 | location) + n_msa + pop_ratio,
  data = standard_wis
)

summary(LRNI)
```

```{r}
plot(LRNI)
qqnorm(resid(LRNI))
qqline(resid(LRNI))
```

```{r}
fixed_effects <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(LRNI))) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

fixed_effects |>
  filter(!grepl(":", term)) |>
  arrange(Estimate)

fixed_effects |>
  filter(grepl(":", term)) |>
  arrange(Estimate)

as.data.frame(ranef(LRNI, condVar = TRUE)) |> arrange(condval)  
```

## NRTL
```{r}
NRTL <- glmmTMB(
  wis ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) + (1 | location) + n_msa + pop_ratio,
  data = standard_wis,
  family = tweedie(link = "log")
)
```

```{r}
summary(NRTL)
simulateResiduals(NRTL, n = 1000, plot = TRUE)
```

# Estimates

```{r}
estimates <- smooth_estimates(model)

make_ci_table <- function(smooth_name, group_var) {
  estimates |>
    filter(.smooth == smooth_name) |>
    select(.smooth, {{ group_var }}, .estimate, .se) |>
    rename(est = .estimate, se = .se) |>
    mutate(
      ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se,
      pct_est   = (exp(est) - 1) * 100,
      pct_lower = (exp(ci_lower) - 1) * 100,
      pct_upper = (exp(ci_upper) - 1) * 100,
      excludes_zero = ci_lower > 0 | ci_upper < 0
    ) |>
    arrange(est)
}

model_id_ci  <- make_ci_table("s(model_id)", model_id)
location_ci  <- make_ci_table("s(location)", location)

horizon_ci   <- make_ci_table("s(horizon)", horizon)
horizon_ci$horizon = as.numeric(horizon_ci$horizon)
horizon_ci$horizon = horizon_ci$horizon

trend_ci <- make_ci_table("s(trend)", trend)
granularity_ci <- make_ci_table("s(granularity)", granularity)

# knitr::kable(model_id_ci |> select(-.smooth))

# knitr::kable(horizon_ci |> select(-.smooth))
# knitr::kable(trend_ci |> select(-.smooth))
# knitr::kable(granularity_ci |> select(-.smooth))
```

# Subfigures

```{r}
fig4a = ggplot(horizon_ci, aes(x = reorder(horizon, -pct_est), y = pct_est)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_lower, ymax = pct_upper), width = 0.2) + 
  geom_point(size = 5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Random effect (% diff on WIS)", x = "Horizon") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5)
  )  
```

```{r}
lookup = read.csv("Data/lookup.csv")
location_ci = location_ci |> left_join(lookup, by = "location")

location_ci$state_level = ifelse(location_ci$state == 'state', 'state', 'not-state')

location_ci = location_ci |> 
  mutate(state = ifelse(state == 'state', as.character(location), state))

state_order = location_ci |>
  distinct(location, state, pct_est) |>
  arrange(state, desc(pct_est))

location_ci = location_ci |> 
  arrange(desc(state_level == 'state'), state, pct_est) |> 
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = state_order$location))

state_boundaries = which(diff(as.numeric(factor(state_order$state, 
                                                 levels = unique(state_order$state)))) != 0) + 0.5
```

```{r}
fig4b = ggplot(location_ci, aes(x = location, y = pct_est, color = state)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = state_boundaries, color = "black", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(location_ci, state_level == "state"), 
             size = 5, shape = 21, fill = NA, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_lower, ymax = pct_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Location", y = "Random effect (% diff on WIS)") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),

  )
```
